create_pipeline: create a Perplexity manifold pipeline with configurable API key and base URL valves
run_perplexity_chat: run a chat completion against the Perplexity API with streaming or non-streaming response
configure_valves: configure Perplexity API valves including base URL and API key from environment variables
build_model_list: build a static list of available Perplexity Sonar and R1 models for the manifold pipeline
review_pipe_method: review the pipe method that forwards messages to Perplexity chat/completions endpoint with citations
